title: Import SRD 5.1 magic item records
description:
﻿Implement D&D SRD 5.1 magic item import coverage.

Problem:
The SRD 5.1 PDF contains a large Magic Items A-Z section with item names, item categories, rarities, attunement information, descriptions, and embedded tables. The current rules pack has no magic-item record kind or equivalent imported records. This is a major gameplay content gap for treasure, rewards, inventory, and item lookup.

Scope:
- Define a magic item record schema/kind if one does not already exist.
- Parse the SRD 5.1 Magic Items A-Z section into deterministic records.
- Capture name, item type/category, rarity when present, attunement requirement when present, description text, source provenance, and license metadata.
- Handle embedded tables either as part of the magic item record or as linked table records, with a documented policy.
- Add reviewed magic item name/count baselines.
- Regenerate the canonical D&D SRD 5.1 pack after implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Magic item records are emitted for the SRD 5.1 Magic Items A-Z section.
- Records have deterministic keys and schema validation.
- Representative records such as Adamantine Armor, Ammunition +1/+2/+3, and Amulet of Health are covered by tests or reviewed baseline checks.
- Attunement and rarity parsing are tested where present.
- Embedded magic item tables are either imported or explicitly documented as intentionally handled inside item text.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings or only documented reviewed findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not introduce Pathfinder work.
close_reason: Implemented SRD 5.1 magic-item import coverage with schema/tool support, exact 236-name baseline, regenerated canonical pack, documented embedded-table policy, and all required verification gates passing.
